about:
# ![🔒](frame:GJ_lock_001.png?scale=0.75) Activate GD!
**Go to settings to activate Geometry Dash.**

*by [Cheeseworks](user:6408873)!*

---

## About
A cosmetic, silly lil' joke mod that just adds an "*Activate Windows*"-like overlay to your game.

---

### Activating
**Yes!** You can <cy>actually *"activate"* your game</c> and make the overlay disappear for your current session by going to your <cg>game settings</c> and <cy>pressing the unlock button</c> to start the activation process. Although, <cr>why would you even want that</c>..?

> ![✳️](frame:collaborationIcon_001.png) <cg>*gd pirata real*</c>

### What Our Customers Said
Some sentences of choice from some people that were approached about this mod.

> "*So good you dont even need massgrave to activate 12/10*"
> - [DominoKiddoo](user:13948595)

> "*i have no mouth and i must scream*"
> - [Uproxide](user:25397826)

> "*i installed this mod and lost 110k$ from my bank account 100% recommended*"
> - [alk1m123](user:11535118)

> "*idk what it does but i give it a thumbs up* ![👍](frame:GJ_likesIcon_001.png?scale=0.5)"
> - [Cvolton](user:761691)

> "*give me a quote that says bus*"
> - [August](user:21207551)

### Live Toggling
You can disable both the activation message overlay and activation button during gameplay if you have [Horrible Menu](mod:cubicstudios.horriblemenu) installed! Find Activate GD's options in their menu.

<mod:cubicstudios.horriblemenu>

---

![🗨️](frame:gj_discordIcon_001.png?scale=0.375) **If you need help, join my [support Discord server](https://www.dsc.gg/cheeseworks) and ask! :)**
